purpose: Evaluate real coordinate outputs, then test broader supervised adaptation without sacrificing native audio/text decisions.

outputs.point: JSON object with exactly x and y, finite normalized coordinates in [0,1]. No snap-to-grid, clipping, answer-derived crop or repair.
outputs.chart: Shortest standalone answer to the original chart question; no answer-derived choices
outputs.choice: Original candidate-code probabilities; no generated probability estimates

omniact.role: GUI training; parse single pointer actions from source scripts as data, never execute scripts; source screenshot and website/application groups stay together

chartqa.license: GPL-3.0 publisher/mirror metadata; research adapter licensing requires separate review before commercial release
chartqa.role: Train from the first pinned training shard; development from val, confirmation from test, with exact image/pixel identity deduplication

boolq.role: Natural passage/question yes-no decisions; train from train, development/confirmation from validation, disjoint normalized passage hashes. The accessible publisher mirror omits article titles; original title-bearing download returned HTTP 403, so article-disjointness is not claimed.

screenspot_v2.role: New coordinate confirmation only; original desktop/web bbox is pixel xywh, converted explicitly to xyxy

screenspot_pro.role: The 117 previously exposed v2 screenshots become development diagnostics for the new coordinate task; never call them fresh confirmation

native_replay.role: Existing train-only speech intent, sound events and paired image/audio cases. Preserve source licenses; SLURP makes the adapter noncommercial research.

sampling.regression: Frozen stratified subsets from the already-exposed MMStar/MMAU/MMLU-Pro audit; diagnostic only, never training

training.target_modules: Language attention q/v projections only; existing parameters frozen, no new vision encoder
training.loss: Answer-token cross entropy for points/charts, supplied-candidate cross entropy for binary/native decisions
training.checkpoint: Final fixed-step checkpoint only; no early stopping or development-selected intermediate checkpoint
training.inference: Merge adapter into BF16 weights; evaluate the merged artifact

selection.training_nomination: Choose the smaller MiniCPM baseline unless Qwen improves development point accuracy by at least 10 percentage points; freeze choice before training
selection.confirmation_nomination: Evaluate exactly the final fixed-step adapter and its unchanged base on untouched confirmation; freeze artifact hashes first
selection.success: Report paired task changes and intervals. Do not declare universal improvement if any material modality regresses. No frontier-parity claim from this bounded study.

metrics: distance to target center as diagnostic only
ChartQA original relaxed numeric/exact text accuracy
new training cost and actual resource use
data_integrity: No cross-partition screenshot, decoded pixel hash, chart or normalized passage groups. Same-article BoolQ overlap beyond exact passages is unknown.
Confirm every label point is a reachable in-box output under the exact coordinate contract
Record all omissions and source-schema errors
Do not publish source media or private credentials in the repository
limitations: ChartQA is chart understanding, not arbitrary PDF/XLSX ingestion
Coordinate generation is a capability baseline and may require multiple output tokens; it does not establish final System One latency
Research-only weights; no automatic playground promotion
